text:
incident-bot: Pager: elevated 5xx rate for /v1/generate in us-west-2. Threshold breached (5m) — callers seeing 502/504. Pager delivered to oncall-sre.

oncall-sre: I'm on it, looking at traces and infra. @maria can you pull model-runner logs?

maria (eng-runtime): grabbing logs now. 2 nodes (model-runner-2a/2b) showing OOM+segfaults in the kv_cache eviction path. corefiles being written to /var/crash.

aj (eng-sre): starting traffic shift policy: reroute 30% -> us-east-1, +canary. Will update LB.

chris (support): Customer impact: multiple tenants report spikes, 4 high-priority customers pinged CS. ETA for initial mitigation?

oncall-sre: initiating rolling restart of model-runner pool with kvcache disabled as quick mitigation. running: `kubectl -n inference set env ds/model-runner RUNTIME_KVCACHE=false`

maria (eng-runtime): log snippet: ```
E 05:14:13 model-runner[4321] kv_cache.cpp:317 eviction failed: double-free
Segmentation fault (core dumped)
#0 0x7f8a2c1b in kvcache::evict()
#1 0x7f8a2d2c in model::forward()
```

maria (eng-runtime): disabling kvcache + restart stops segfaults locally. will push restart across the ds. collecting cores for postmortem.

aj (eng-sre): LB change in progress, now at 60% shift to us-east-1. autoscaler scaled runners +2 in us-east-1.

oncall-sre: monitor shows 5xx rate dropping, tailing metrics.

chris (support): CS updated top customers and shared temporary mitigation note. No data loss, just errors/latency.

kelly (customer-success): published short status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1712345678 — referencing mitigation and ETA for root-cause. Customers on threads notified.

maria (eng-runtime): grabbing kor dumps and symbolicated traces. hypothesis: concurrent eviction race causing double-free on the kvcache when memory pressure + compaction coincide. Patch idea: add atomic guard + defensive null-check, or temporarily remove async compaction.

oncall-sre: mitigation effective — error rate back to baseline within ~6 minutes of action. Keeping pager open for validation and handoff.

aj (eng-sre): starting canary promote in us-east-1 to restore capacity, leaving kvcache disabled in us-west-2 until patch validated.

maria (eng-runtime): creating GH issue and PR for defensive fix, will run stress + long-run load test in staging. Attaching cores to incident ticket.

oncall-sre: handing off to morning shift in #incidents at 08:00 PT. Action items: (1) maria: root-cause + PR, (2) aj: rollback routing after patch + test, (3) kelly/chris: continue customer comms.

incident-bot: Pager cleared at 1712346098.

oncall-sre: thanks all — closing incident thread once postmortem draft is posted. :tada:
